svg.title: Review a proposed change before it reaches the shared code
svg.desc: A branch gives an edit a separate place to live. A pull request invites a teammate to review it. Branch. Start the change away from the shared version. Check. Inspect the edits and run the project’s tests. Review. Open the pull request. A teammate can check the evidence before approving the change.
